DualProtocolSaajSoapMessageFactory - Class in swiss.trustbroker.wstrust.service
Workaround to support both SOAP 1.1 and 1.2.
This class determines the SOAP version via content-type header and dispatches to a SaajSoapMessageFactory configured for the matching SOAP version.
The SOAP version from the inbound is stored in a thread local for use in the outbound (where we have no information).
DualProtocolSaajSoapMessageFactory(SaajSoapMessageFactory, SaajSoapMessageFactory) - Constructor for class swiss.trustbroker.wstrust.service.DualProtocolSaajSoapMessageFactory
